question: If an AI assistant remembers us across every task, how much should it be allowed to keep?
reflection: An assistant that remembers our goals could save effort and support learning, as long as we can always see and remove what it holds.

sources.subject: OpenAI Jalapeño Chip, Anthropic Claude Unified Memory, Perplexity

one_line: AI companies are competing on the systems around their models: memory, chips and where the work runs.

top_stories.title: Assistant memory shared across chat and tasks
top_stories.what: Anthropic now lets Claude keep one memory across ordinary chats and longer agent tasks, on by default, with a settings page to view, edit or delete what it has saved.
top_stories.why: Memory raises clear questions of consent and control that behavioural research can help answer.

top_stories.title: OpenAI shows its own inference chip
top_stories.what: OpenAI shared results for Jalapeño, a chip made with Broadcom to run its models, which it says was designed in nine months with help from its own AI and targets about half the cost per reply.
top_stories.why: Lower running costs could make AI services cheaper for organisations over time.

top_stories.title: Agent that runs fully on a desk computer
top_stories.what: Perplexity released an agent that plans and acts entirely on a local machine, keeps sensitive files on the device and asks before sending any step to the cloud.
top_stories.why: Local agents suit teams that handle personal or confidential research data.

saudi_lens.text: Local agents that keep data on the device fit Saudi data protection rules and the push for data to stay inside the Kingdom.

idea.title: What should my assistant remember?
idea.pitch: Run a study on which kinds of personal details people are happy for an AI to remember, and how clear controls change that comfort.
idea.first_step: List fifteen kinds of personal details and plan a quick card-sorting session with ten people.

idea_kids.title: The forgetful robot
idea_kids.pitch: A story book about a helper robot that asks before it remembers anything, teaching children that their information belongs to them.
idea_kids.first_step: Sketch eight pages where the robot asks: may I remember this?

watchlist.name: Prime Intellect
watchlist.note: Says its open agent harness lifted a hard puzzle test score from 30% to over 95%.

tool.name: Perplexity Portable Computer
tool.use: Runs a full agent on your own hardware so files stay local; asks before using the cloud.

verify: OpenAI's chip reportedly targets about 50% lower cost per response than NVIDIA's best chips.

terms.definition: The stage when a trained AI model is used to produce an answer, as opposed to being trained.
Information an agent keeps between sessions so it does not start from zero each time.
Software run on your own computers or servers rather than through an outside provider.

concepts.summary: Assistants keep one memory across chat and tasks, with user controls.
AI labs build their own chips to cut the cost of running models.
Agents that run fully on local hardware keep data in place.
